label: bar-interact-a11-v1: the A11 (d) motion key of the A-bar meter's part 2 (Design queue #113), sealed before the meter's version 4 code existed and before any real page was measured for A11 (d)
notes: The seal is the key's sha256 (files). pages_at_seal records the fixture pages, styles and script as they were when the key was sealed, for reference: a page may only be corrected so that it is what the key says it is, with the reason written in docs/design-homepage-bar-interaction.md; the key never changes. Before sealing, every page was loaded in the browser (playwright-mcp Chromium) at 1440x900 and 390x844, normal and reduced motion, with a scratch probe that is not the meter: the animations it reported (kind, name, target, duration, iterations, delay, timing functions), smooth scrolling, scroll-timeline progress and the planted parts' layout boxes matched each page's plant. Never edit this file; a new key is bar-interact-a11-v2.
